events.text: Emaad ran into his arch-nemesis and was pushed; a car came out of nowhere from the road.
Emaad competed in the World Cup Boxing Final against Shavez; Emaad was rushed to the hospital and passed away.
The match resumed tomorrow; Emaad lost a match for the first time.
Emaad faced CrustiChezz from Romania; they tied and Emaad won by stronger punch.
